Lisa_CustOps: Hey — customer reported failing tool invocation with a confusing schema error: 422 'additionalProperties' -> 'payment_meta'. Payload looks fine on their side. They say this started after a client SDK update.
Serena_Support: Thanks Lisa. Do we have the raw request and the validator error? Any stack or correlation id?
support-bot: Incoming request id=req_0b9f3a2; route=/v1/invoke; model=tool-runner-v2; status=422; validator=tool-invoke-validator; err=additionalProperties: payment_meta
Lisa_CustOps: Copied from customer:```json
{
  "tool": "billing_invoke",
  "args": {
    "customer_id": "C-99321",
    "invoice": {"amount": 1200, "currency": "USD"}
  },
  "payment_meta": { "gateway": "stripe", "trace": "t-122" }
}
```
They say previous SDK omitted payment_meta; new SDK attaches it automatically.
Mike_Infrastructure: Hmm — validator schema for billing_invoke explicitly sets "additionalProperties": false for the top-level object in prod. That would reject any unexpected keys like `payment_meta`. Was there a recent schema tighten?
Raj_EngML: Quick check: in repo at infra/schemas/tool-invoke/billing_invoke.json I see top-level required keys ["tool","args"] and additionalProperties=false. Looks deliberate. But older gateway had a compatibility shim that stripped unknown top keys. Did that get removed?
Serena_Support: @Mike any deploys to gateway or router that might stop shim behavior? Also need to know if customer token scopes changed (auth mismatch can surface as different error).
Mike_Infrastructure: We rolled out router v3 on 2025-11-02 02:14 UTC which disabled the "strip-external-keys" compatibility flag for performance. That probably removed the shim.
Lisa_CustOps: Customer is on SDK 2.5.0 (released today) which adds `payment_meta`. So two coincident changes: SDK now sends the extra key and router stopped stripping unknown keys -> 422. Customer is upset about break.
Raj_EngML: Options: 1) Re-enable shim at router layer (fast rollback) 2) Extend schema to allow `payment_meta` (longer review) 3) Add a gateway middleware that strips unknown top-level keys for known stable tools.
Serena_Support: For immediate mitigation recommend re-enabling shim for the affected route and publish a rollback hotfix. Lisa, can you ask customer to temporarily downgrade SDK to 2.4.x as a hot workaround?
Lisa_CustOps: Done, asked customer to downgrade; they're test-deploying now.
Mike_Infrastructure: I'll patch a short-lived flag to re-enable strip-external-keys for /v1/invoke billing_invoke route and push canary now. Noted: must watch latency impact.
Raj_EngML: Follow-up: we should update schema docs and add a compatibility note to SDK release notes. Also consider making top-level additionalProperties true but forcing args strictness to avoid accidental tool routing issues.
Serena_Support: Approved. @Mike monitor 95th pct latency. If latency goes >10% we abort and try middleware approach.
Mike_Infrastructure: Canary looks good so far. No latency spike at 5k rps. Patch going to 30% then full.
Lisa_CustOps: Customer confirmed downgrade fixed it. Will keep them posted on rollback timeline. :thumbsup:
Serena_Support: Filing follow-up ticket to product and SDK teams to coordinate a more permanent fix and better contract between SDK and router. Thanks all.
